purpose: One FIELD egress mechanism: strict shape/authority rules for new packets plus a compatibility adapter for recovered historical packet forms.

canonical_fields.OBJECT: Required. Exact addressed thing carried by the packet.
canonical_fields.AUTHORITY: Required. Source/owner constraints. Packet-local fields never grant NOW; caller CURRENT/selection context does.
canonical_fields.DELTA: Optional material change. DELTA must be material and witnessed.
canonical_fields.EVIDENCE: Required for canonical DELTA. May be direct evidence or refs with sufficient=true.
canonical_fields.RESIDUE: Unresolved returned work, contradiction, defect, authority conflict, or unwitnessed material change.
canonical_fields.WAITING: External human/device/world/private prerequisite; maps to GATE.
canonical_fields.NEXT: Fresh candidate continuation. At most 3 executable entries.
canonical_fields.STOP: Conditional STOP -> GATE. Terminal STOP + unresolved material -> RESIDUE. Completed terminal STOP -> ARCHIVE.

return_dispositions.CLOSE: ARCHIVE unless a higher GATE condition is present
return_dispositions.RESIDUE: RESIDUE unless GATE/NOW already owns the packet
return_dispositions.CONTRADICTION: RESIDUE unless GATE/NOW already owns the packet
return_dispositions.TRIGGER: NEXT only when a bounded executable NEXT exists and execution is explicitly authorized; otherwise GATE

canonical_rules: Missing OBJECT/AUTHORITY or unknown RETURN disposition -> ARCHIVE quarantine.
Packet egress labels are hints only and cannot manufacture any class.
WAITING / conditional STOP / blocked TRIGGER -> GATE.
RETURN CLOSE -> ARCHIVE after GATE has been considered.
Terminal STOP never leaks into NEXT: unresolved material -> RESIDUE; otherwise ARCHIVE.
NOW requires caller context.now/context.selected and is blocked by AUTHORITY.can_select_now=false.
Unresolved fact, contradiction, authority conflict, or unwitnessed material DELTA -> RESIDUE.
Witnessed material DELTA with no higher egress -> DELTA.

legacy_compatibility.law: Recovered packet shapes preserve the same GATE -> NOW -> RESIDUE -> NEXT -> DELTA -> ARCHIVE precedence. NOW still requires caller CURRENT/selection context; DELTA still requires sufficient evidence; packet egress labels remain hints only.
legacy_compatibility.non_promotion: Historical/superseded material remains ARCHIVE unless explicitly reactivated.

invariants: RETURN closes the previous move; NEXT is a fresh offer.
NEXT visibility is bounded to <=3 for canonical packets.
UNWITNESSED DELTA is RESIDUE, not change truth.
SUCCESSFUL CLOSE disappears from ordinary attention.
INVALID canonical packets quarantine to ARCHIVE and cannot alter CONTROL.
No reducer creates a queue, planner, route, store, priority, dashboard, or effect authority.
